searchText: Does 1559 solves the transaction being stuck when it was broadcasted during the raising gas price? Not in and of itself. If you set the `maxFeePerGas` to 2 x the current base fee, and the next 6 blocks are (doubly) full with txs that have higher `maxPriorityFeePerGas`, then you're out of luck. Rip then Sending ethereum transactions without rebroadcasting them with higher gas price seems to be impossible Not sure what you mean to be honest. We send 1000+ transactions daily Every one hour And every one or two days the payouts are stuck Because of the stupid gas price increase Rebroadcasting them is the only way to get them through Why not send them with a higher `maxFeePerGas` then? (hypothetically after London) I have no idea what `maxFeePerGas` is sorry (I'm also not sure what you mean with "payouts". Obviously not mining pool -> miner payouts, as those would never be stuck) OK, so why not send with a higher gas price? (talking in current terms) ah yes payouts we are a mining pool payouts = transactions How can those be stuck if _you're_ the one mining them? We are not mining them Because that would essentially make miners earning less Constantly fluctuating gas price is the single thing I hate the most in ethereum Just set the `maxFeePerGas` to the maximum you're willing to pay then, and get a rebate for the difference. Yeah I guess this is what we will use After 1559 is out Currently you indeed have to guess rather accurately, as there's no rebate if you overestimated If it was not burning the base fee, I'd absolutely love this eip > Currently you indeed have to guess rather accurately Using gas price oracle equal to gasnow's Rapid gas price Still gets stuck 😵 Yeh, so at least EIP-1559 will make that a bit better. I'm not entirely convinced it's cheaper to let other pools mine your payouts though, I'd say the cost is the same (or slightly cheaper if you include them yourself probably). And at least they don't get stuck. It is profitable to include the highest paying transactions And if we will include our transactions with the gas price of 28.9 gwei currently obviously it will be less profitable Miners would kill us if they would see this 😂 This discussion has also come up repeatedly a few months back, with some mining pools thinking payouts were gonna get more expensive with EIP-1559. I don't think there's a way around paying roughly `<highest paying but not-included tx in mining pool> * 21k` for every payout. this is possible, though, it will introduce hell a lot of complexity since we will need to sign transactions on the fly and include them to our blocks and the more complex the system is, the more chances that it will fuck up and we cannot let it be true cos we have tons of eth on the mining address It's fine if you let other pools mine the payouts, just saying that the costs are about the same 🙂 Anyway, this is way off topic for EIP-1559. Yeah, but this doesn't apply to the current case haha The market gas price is 90 gwei whereas our transactions are 28 gwei Yeah haha Fingers crossed that 1559 will fix that Sorry to bump this again but could someone help me out with understanding the implications of EIP-1559 on submitting new transactions with same nonce in an attempt to supersede the original transaction? Also would probably be beneficial to wallet devs to include in <@!420951281910284289> and <@!552133098075193354> 's cheat sheet (which I love, thank you 🙏🏻 ) tim is off today, but I will make sure he sees this and responds ahead of the call. > (which I love, thank you 🙏🏻 ) glad it's helpful! there's probably a bunch we can as well, suggestions welcome
